scene_description: A teacher, Ms. Smith, stands in a classroom in front of a green chalkboard with math problems written on it. She is smiling and pointing towards the students. Several children are seated at desks, with their backs mostly to the viewer, and many have their hands raised, eager to answer.

questions.question: What do you think Ms. Smith will do next after she points to a child?
What do you think Ms. Smith asked the children right before they raised their hands?
Do you like to raise your hand in school or at home when you know an answer?
What else could the children be learning about in school today, besides numbers?
Why do you think Ms. Smith is smiling in the classroom?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at her face and imagine why she's happy.
